text.text: Inhabited for centuries. Burnt and looted by Malabar pirates.
Sultan Mohamed Shamsuddeen III spent part of his exile here, after first being banished to Fuvahmulah.
Villimalé’s history, from the 16th century to 2026. Compiled by the Villimalé group from Wikipedia.
The people living here were moved to Hulhulé, to clear the land for a state-run farm.
A high-security prison was built for political prisoners, after the state farm was cancelled.
